overloadPatches.semanticRole: Selects item(s) by position within the hierarchical list identified by its object name (list is a Text form-object name) -- selected via the leading '*' parameter.

discriminatedBy.rule: Passing the leading literal '*' selects this object-name form: list is a Text list object name rather than a numeric ListRef.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Selects item(s) by position within the hierarchical list identified by its reference number (list is an Integer ListRef) -- no leading '*' passed.

discriminatedBy.rule: Omitting the leading '*' selects this reference-number form: list is an Integer hierarchical list reference (ListRef).

constraints: The object-name form (leading '*') is required rather than optional if the same list has several representations (each with its own expanded/collapsed configuration) in the current form; if the list has only one representation, either syntax works.
If the @ wildcard is used in the list object name and several matching list objects exist on the form, the command applies only to the first matching object.
itemPos must be a value between 1 and the value returned by Count list items, expressed using the list's current expanded/collapsed state.
